main_body: Ground terrain patch (farm field): wheat/golden crop rows at top, green crop bushes in the middle, and brown tilled soil furrows with grass tufts at the bottom, with a grass border on the left and bottom.
top_band: none (flat ground terrain patch, no standing object; the golden wheat rows read as a top-down surface texture)
evidence: The candidate is a terrain tile block (farm ground), not a standing object, so the 3/4 top-and-front contract does not apply. It is a flat ground surface of crop rows and soil furrows with no side faces and no elevation. Nothing in it conflicts with the terrain kind, so it is judged as ground.

style.evidence: The wheat rows use about 5 yellow/orange/cream steps with per-pixel speckle. The green crops carry 4-5 greens in leaf clumps, and the soil has dark brown, mid brown and light brown grain with grass tufts. The dark edges next to soil are dark brown and next to leaves dark green, so the outlines follow the neighbouring material rather than a neutral black. There are no large flat fills, and the information per tile is at least as rich as the plain grass and paving references.
